ListPreference.android:title: Car screen shape
ListPreference.android:summary: Detected from your head unit automatically; override only if it's wrong
Match the head unit's reported display, or force a size

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-detect DPI
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Use this phone's own screen density for the AA session

EditTextPreference.android:title: Manual DPI
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Only used when auto-detect is off

Preference.android:title: Car profiles
Preference.android:summary: Save/load video and AA settings per car (screen shape, resolution, fill mode, etc.)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Remember settings per car
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Screen, video and car button settings are kept for each car and come back when that car connects. Changes you make belong to the car you connected to last.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Downscale resolution
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Send AA a 720p frame instead of 1080p -- fewer pixels for the same adaptive bitrate to cover, less blocky. Separate from Custom resolution below.

ListPreference.android:title: Car screen fill
ListPreference.android:summary: AA has no resolution matching this car's screen shape, so one of these is unavoidable

ListPreference.android:title: Mic / speaker for Android Auto
ListPreference.android:summary: Which device handles AA voice/media audio in and out

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Home button over Android Auto
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A small button at the edge of Android Auto that goes to the car home screen, where YouTube, Claude and the other tiles are.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Side strip next to Android Auto
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A strip at the edge of the car screen with the time, the speed, a home button, and YouTube and Claude buttons. Android Auto is drawn for the space that is left. Best on wide screens.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Speed in the corner of Android Auto
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A small GPS speed readout over the top corner. Not shown with the side strip, which has its own.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Lower video when the phone overheats
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: When the phone reports severe heat, Android Auto restarts once at 720p and 30 fps and stays there until the drive ends. Nothing changes if it is already at that.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Parked detection
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Tell Android Auto the car is parked only while GPS shows it stopped, so the keyboard and parked-only apps work then. While moving, or without a GPS fix, the normal driving limits apply. Needs location allowed.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-crop to car screen shape
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Computes the AA video crop automatically from this car's real screen size, instead of a plain letterbox. Turn off if the picture looks worse than Fit/Fill alone.

PreferenceCategory.android:title: Car home screen and phone screen

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open on the car home screen
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: When the car connects, show the home screen with its tiles. Off opens Android Auto straight away.

EditTextPreference.android:title: More web apps
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Adds tiles to the car home screen next to YouTube and Claude. Type names and addresses separated by commas, like: Tarteel=tarteel.ai, Quran=quran.com, WhatsApp=web.whatsapp.com

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Weather on the car home screen
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Shows the outside temperature. To get it, your position, rounded to about a kilometre, is sent to open-meteo.com every half hour.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Hide web pages and the phone screen while moving
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Web pages and the phone's screen on the car are covered unless GPS shows the car stopped; sound keeps playing. Turn off only for passengers: the screen is in the driver's view, and video in sight of the driver is illegal in many places.
Reconnect automatically if the USB link drops

ListPreference.android:title: USB role override (debug)
ListPreference.android:summary: Confirmed: phone is the USB accessory, head unit is the host. Only override for testing.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Check automatically
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Check once per app launch; only notifies when something newer actually exists

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Protocol sniffer
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Log every CarbitLink/Android Auto control message with a hex preview, including video/audio frames (noisy -- exported from Developer tools)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: On-screen debug overlay
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Show fps/bitrate/drops over the mirror, AA session, and this app's own screen

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Auto-save crash log to Downloads
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: On a crash, save the current log straight to Downloads automatically -- no need to dig through Developer tools afterward
